TSMC raised 2026 capex guidance to $60-64bn and its revenue growth outlook above 40%, and Micron pre-guided FQ4 revenue of $49-51bn at an 86% gross margin ahead of its Sep 30 report -- both reinforce Pillar B's supply-chain green. Net effect: yellows fell from 7 to 6 with zero reds, a small move away from 'popping,' but the macro amplifier's own signals (F1, F2) are now closer to their thresholds than at any point since the baseline.
